message.reasoning_content: License pays 20-60 alashi (~20-60M units) beyond bank share. Cash-rich; winning bid worth it. Bank 30M + bid. Bid moderate, say 25M (choice 54). Rivals have ~30-33M cash; need to outbid them. Bid 30M (choice 59) likely safe? They could bid all. License income expectation ~40M, so bid up to ~35M still profitable. Choose 32M (choice 61) — tie_order puts me last (1,2,0), so equal bids lose. Go 35M? That leaves 15.7M cash, but ranking counts cash, not license... ranking by cash; winner's bid goes to bank and redistributed 50:30:15, so part comes back. If I win with 35M, I get back ~50% of 65M bank. Fine, choose 35M (choice 64).
